blocks.text:
<Elly>
"So this is the Mass
Driver... The power is still
on."<New><Elly>
"The hangar has an entrance
outside. Citan will bring our
Gears in that way."<New><Elly>
"He'll meet us at Central
Control."<New><Elly>
"We have to send Taura's
capsule into the upper
atmosphere."<New><Elly>
"Once the nanomachines
spread, they should remove
the Limiter."<New><Emeralda>
"Emeralda ready! Come on,
Elly!"<New><Elly>
"All right. Let's go."<Close>

<Elly>
"The controls should be
somewhere below us.
Let's look for a directory."<Close>

<Emeralda>
"Even after all this time...
the old lift still moves."<Close>

SURFACE ACCESS LIFT
DESCENT CIRCUIT ACTIVE<Close>

CAUTION
Stand clear of the platform edge.<Close>
